# infisical_audit_log_stream_custom (Resource)

Stream organization audit logs to a custom HTTP endpoint. Requires a plan with audit log streaming and an identity with organization settings permissions. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

# Any endpoint that accepts a JSON array of audit log events. Batches are bounded at 500 events
# or 1 MB per request, so the receiver has to handle an array rather than a single object.
resource "infisical_audit_log_stream_custom" "better_stack" {
  credentials = {
    url = "https://in.logs.betterstack.com"
    headers = {
      Authorization = "Bearer <your-source-token>"
    }
  }

  filters = {
    products = ["organization"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) The a custom HTTP endpoint delivery credentials. Secret values cannot be read back from the API, so drift in them is not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes) Scopes which audit logs the stream receives. Omit to stream every product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The audit log stream ID.
- `stream_mode` (String) How events are delivered. Read-only: new streams are always created in batch mode.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Request headers to send, keyed by header name. Usually carries the destination's auth token. Applies leave unchanged header values alone, so a rotation done in Infisical survives.
- `url` (String) The endpoint that receives batched audit logs as a JSON array. http is accepted for collectors on a trusted private network, but sends audit events and the headers below in the clear and warns at plan time; prefer https.


<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Optional:

- `products` (Set of String) Products to stream: secret-manager, cert-manager, kms, secret-scanning, pam, agent-vault, organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import infisical_audit_log_stream_custom.example <audit_log_stream_id>

# The API returns header values redacted, so the first plan after an import shows the headers
# being set. The URL is imported as configured in Infisical.
```
